content: Web grins to the doll. "I on't suppose you feel like talking?"
(only bae and web are at the top)
The doll bares its fangs at you.
Web grins back with their sharp teeth. "Please."
Baeshra nods to the feral doll. "Only talk. No want fight."
A cackling shriek pierces the evening. It stills the woods around you.
"I cannot speak for everyone here. But I do want to talk. I would rather not come to blows here."
the response to web is a terrifying vision.
A green light flickers in the distance
"Everyone stay close we dont want anyone getting lost"
Web blinks their stony eyes. "Too late for talking, it seems. It's been too late for a long time, hasn't it?"
The wood seems rotten and in disrepair.
When Cato stops, Rigatony watches him to make sure he doesn't have a mental break down as they walk.
Ozgur shakes his head at the shoddy carpentry.
"We are being watched. Followed by creatures. They might be spying with them."
Web looks to the wood. "We could help fix it."
"Baeshra sorry much bad happen to you. What Baeshra do to help?"
The rope is decorated with fetishes and trinkets and shrunken heads.
Wren pulls out her handaxe, bow discarded, on her back
"I know quite a lot about decay. I know what's it like to be seperate, to be persecuted." They hold their hands up, showing they mean no harm. "May I enter?"
Lilia has her staff in her hand, mace on her hip
Web shakes their head. "The more are up here the less safe we may be, paradoxically."
"I figure I could make that climb quick If I had to..." Ozgur says eyeing the trunk.
Web takes a step towards the central building, looking for any response.
You come to the green light flickering on the rocky outcroppings
"What a nice shade of green" he puts a hand on his chin and evaluates the design choice
Rockman leans in.... "Could use more blues"
Rigatony nods in approval of the landscape architecture robot
Web shifts into feral mode and looks around for any sign of a trap

Rigatony looks at him as he speaks to the air

"they are being controlled.... and the voices... i think... are pushing us forward... without us knowing"
Web looks up above them for any sign of other traps

A dark figure is seen wtihin
They shrink back into the cave entrance

Your investigation reveals a butcher table covered in the remains of many animals. The floor is stained with the blood staining the floorboards.
Lilia looks at Rigatony "Perhaps we could come to some type of agreement." She still holds her staff ready to hit something
There are no more obvious traps in this room
i love having speak with animals as an at will....
"ssandy andd I are probably besst suited for peace or arrangement"
Rigatony draws his sword "Yes, an agreement"
The animals gather into a wall of dear and rabbits, squirrels, and wolves
A foul stench. The smell of sweat and fear permeates the room
Web takes a step cautiously towards the butcher table, not touching anything.

"Stay in the back still. We cant allow them to hit you first."
fingernails and claws litter the table
“Alright, I think we should all continue up”

there should be something on your screen to click when you want to talk.
stands.... waiting for the decision to be made
“I don’t think we should leave Baeshra and web alone up there”
"Baeshra know bad happen much long ago with new people. We no want be like bad people. Want live with land. No want hurt people or tribes here. "
Web sighs. "Slow and careful if you do please."
"Gil approach but stay behind me and Rig, Viola as well."
"we sshould att least try rightt?" she says shyly
Ozgur turns to Copper "Should more go up, or all of us?"
Are there any signs of human activity recently?
"Yeah, i'm not liking this so far.." Adrian kinda shifts back and forth on his feet.
looking at the animals "what do you wish?"
“Splitting up might not be the best course of action here. It’ll be safe for us to stay together”
scraps of clothing, are the only sign of human life.
While the animals circle you The figure behind them walks calmly towards you all
There is a building to the north and to the south.
(Just realized this is the music we died to 😭)
Web exits and makes towards the north building slowly
Riga lowers the tip of his sword, "Hello, we don't mean any harm"
Ozgur's made up his mind, he starts to climb, Chaimail clunking noisily.
The animals stop circling and part for this figure before you
looks up to the figure "Mother Elizabeth I assume?"
Lilia looks around at everyone. Watching to see what will happen
Baeshra stays with Web. "Any one hear Baeshra?"
The acrid smell of lye and sulfur is coming from the northern building. It is decorated with nightshade.
Web enters cautiously, looking for any presences or traps
She raises a hand and the animals take a step back
Wynne comes in at the back of the group.
A smile creeps across her face
Wren takes a step back, in response
Riga waits for Gill to speak
There is a trip wire near the door.
Her voice is scatchy yet analytical

Once at the top, copper looks at the brown mold.

Rockman stands motionless, Rush mimics him.

They enter the room, stepping over the wire
Dex save dc 6 to pass the trip wire you are aware of, everyone who is coming together.
pauses "I do belong here..... but I understand your point..... what would your terms be for us to stay?"
"You may stay among your own kind...Chinnokin. The rest must leave"
Ozgur looks around, he kneels down and places the doll face down "Nighty night freaky thing." He says gently patting it.
"thay have no means to leave... so again... what are the terms for them to stay?"
Web is prepared to use their symbiotic entity feature upon being attacked or agressed against
"There is no place for you here"
The north building is some sort of apothecary full of bits of creatures.
Storm stands there anxiously watching to see what will happen
Web walks around, looking at the various bits and nodding knowingly at several of them.
"it looks like, my diplomacy has failed... maybe sir cato will ahve better words than I"
(they are eyes and they are turning to watch you as you walk through the room.)
"Colonists plague all they touch, destroy in the name of their gods, kill those who do not think like them"
"Don't disturb anything. If any chance of peace, won't happen if disturb things."
(are we all near web and baeshra now?)
Baeshra nods to the separate ingredients. "Seers tools no touch. Much bad to who dishonor seers."
THUMP. something is climbing on top of the north building.
Cato nods and moves to attack
Web exits the building, looking at the roof
A hook like appendage bursts through the top narrowly missing you.

She smiles
"Make yourselves at home"
She disappears as Cato rushes forward, gone
the party outside sees a strange beast sitting atop the hut.
Web climbs onto the top of the hut. "Hello?"
Those 4 go in but before the others follow, the animals charge as a horde at them outside
it makes an attack against web.
DC 12 Dex save or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage

The creature ambles forward. (anyone can attack but everyone will need to expend 30 feet of movement to get on top of the hut)

9 bldg damage to Rockman and Rush

The animals move away as they go

Use Lay on Hands on Web. Heals to full.

the owl sees only this image.

"Rock man please give Wren two sandiberries."
it is caught, and it's attacks fail
She grabs the berries and stares down Rockman
looks at wren and offers two berries without touching her "please friend"
Viola stares confused at this encounter
Rockman stands, his back to Wren, looking down to her over his shoulder.
"Please! I know it's angry and violent but please!"
"It would seem that i was wrong about you."
"Web felt that way sometimes. Let me try and calm it!"
"It's... It's like some kind of Puawai karaka." Ozgur says trying to make sense of the thing as it thrashes.
It begins to ooze and puff up
"thank you...  wren.... if you get hurt... let me know, and i will help you, so you dont have to deal with him if you dont want to"
Copper is happy he is not on the roof. He ducks back inside
Ozgur nearly falls off the platform and then stops backing up.
“I don’t even know what I’ve done wrong. You hate me and yet I am not aware of why.” She says to Rockman. Her eyes are hard
"Not the time." His voice is stern
Everyone but oz and sir wynne, make a dc 15 con save
"Ask Cato!" As he points at Cato before walking away.
“Don’t you tell *me* when the correct time is.”
(Imma say that was Ozgur's danger sense tingling.)
She snaps at him, “You are a disgrace and a coward.”
It erupts into a cloud of spores.

Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and become infected with a disease on a failed save. Creatures immune to the poisoned condition are immune to this disease.

Spores invade an infected creature's system, killing the creature in a number of hours equal to 1d12+the creature's Constitution score, unless the disease is removed. In half that time, the creature becomes poisoned for the rest of the duration. After the creature dies, it sprouts 2d4 Tiny gas spores that grow to full size in 7 days.
(Baeshra is still in the house, still effected?)
Skitter pulls out his honey ointment and cures himself of one poison and heals 2d8+2 hp "anyone else want some?"

Web sighs. THey approach the husk
"If everything here does that it will be very hard to make peace..." Ozgur says looking at everyone cough.
Wren walks forward. Her grip tightens on her handaxe.
A large swinging blade comes down from the ceiling
Everyone make me a dex save DC 14 or take 2d10

12 slashing damage as it passes through you

leading from the north building there is a path to the east and the west.

Copper turns to skitter, he coughs. “I’m not feeling well. Not at all.”

Several waves of spikes shoot from a nearby wall
only take it if you failed

Copper sees his parents behind dragged away from him with chains which are yanked by Tiamat. She laughs as she swallows them whole.
He is alone, hearing her laughter

Ozgur sees himself on a bloodred hellscape, Axe in hand, wearing obsidian-plate mail. On one side, a wave of horrific demons charges towards legions of devils. Ozgur charges into the frey, slaying Abomination after endless Abomination. He fights, and he kills, and he wins. He never dies. There is no death, only war.

Web slumps to the floor as visions fill their mind. They see the journal they have kept about what they've been told about Skitter turn blank, its pages disappearing. They see their memories, their new ones of him vanish. And then the same for each of their other friends. Baeshra is last to go, everything Web loves about her gone on the wind as though it never was.
oz, web, copper, adrian roll a d100
A magical arcane rune glows above you

Adrian flashes to a tent, full of wounded people. Women, Children. The old and the young. All are need him but he is the only one who can help. The end continues endlessly. He can't help them all...he can't...they will all die...

OZ, for the rest of the day: The character becomes attached to a “lucky charm,” such as a person or an object, and has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws while more than 30 feet from it.
The character experiences vivid hallucinations and has disadvantage on ability checks.
DC 15 Dex or take half of 5d8 lightning damage

The character suffers from partial amnesia. The character knows who he or she is and retains racial traits and class features, but doesn’t recognize other people or remember anything that happened before the madness took effect.
